title: Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season's 2nd Part Announces New Cast Member, October 11 Debut
content: The staff for Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season , the sequel to the 2019-2020 anime of Yūji Terajima 's Ace of Diamond Act II ( Daiya no A Act II ) manga, revealed the key visual, new cast member, and October 11 debut for its second cours (quarter of a year) on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Day Celebrated With 99 Announcements, New Key Visual, Video, Hajime Isayama Art, YouTube Channel and More
content: September 9 is being celebrated as the first officially recognized Attack on Titan Day, with the franchise sharing 99 pieces of news from around the world as part of a large anniversary campaign.
author: Anime Corner

title: Bleach Final Season Shares New Looks at Ichigo & More Ahead of Anime’s Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is fast approaching the anime’s final episode, and some special events coming up have revealed some cool new looks at Ichigo Kurosaki and the others ahead of that grand finale.
author: ComicBook

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 Remake Game's Videos Reveal November 5 Release
content: Nintendo revealed during The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct on Tuesday video gameplay for the Nintendo Switch 2 remake for the 1998 Nintendo 64 game The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , and it announces that the game will launch on November 5.
author: ANN

title: New Godzilla Minus Zero Trailer Reveals First Full Look at New Sequel – Watch Now
content: Godzilla Minus Zero is coming to screens worldwide with its highly anticipated sequel later this Fall , and a new trailer is showing off the first full look at what to expect from the big movie.
author: ComicBook

title: Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 Cour 2 New Key Visual Teases Seido vs Inashiro Match Ahead of October 11 Premiere
content: Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 revealed a new key visual for its second cour, set to continue with the Seido vs Inashiro match on October 11, 2026. Taking over from Madhouse is studio OLM, which is animating the sequel with Hideaki Oba as the director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Magic Repo Man Anime Unveils New Trailer, Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content: The new trailer for Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest anime unveils the opening and ending theme songs of the series and an additional cast member.
author: Anime Corner

title: Hotel Inhumans Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Theme Songs
content: The previously announced Hotel Inhumans Season 2 revealed a new visual and trailer featuring the opening and ending theme songs on Tuesday. GAN performs the opening theme song, “Rasen,” and Phantom Siita sings the ending theme song, “Sweet Pea.” The anime is slated to begin on October 4.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Third Opening Featuring "DIVE TO WORLD" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its third opening, featuring the song “DIVE TO WORLD” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 52-73, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime's 2nd Video Unveils More Cast, Half-Year Run
content: The staff for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series revealed on Tuesday the anime's second promotional video, four more cast members, and its broadcast run of…
